options.name: --backend
options.description: GPU backend: auto, vulkan, cuda. Default: auto (prefers  CUDA when -g is set and CUDA is available, otherwise Vulkan).

options.name: --ctx-size
options.description: Context size / max sequence length (0 = model default)

options.name: --draft-model
options.description: Path to a smaller draft model for speculative decoding  (greedy only, requires --temp 0)

options.name: --expert-stats
options.description: MoE: write GPU expert-cache (SLRU) hit-rate stats to this  file on exit. Env: SHARPI_EXPERT_STATS.

options.name: --hide-thinking
options.description: Hide reasoning output (the model still reasons; only the  answer is shown)

options.name: --max-thinking-tokens
options.description: Maximum reasoning tokens before forcing  </think>. 0 = unlimited (default). Not honored on the  speculative-decode path.

options.name: --min-batch-blas
options.description: Minimum batch size to use OpenBLAS SGEMM in MatMulBatched  (default: 16, crossover for Q4_K_M weights). Also settable via  SHARPI_MIN_BATCH_BLAS env var.

options.name: --min-p
options.description: Min-p sampling (default: 0.05)

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to GGUF model file

options.name: --moe-warmpin
options.description: MoE: also pin the top-N hottest experts per layer into the GPU cache after warmup (default 0 = off; frequency-aware eviction already  retains hot experts). Env: SHARPI_MOE_WARMPIN.

options.name: --moe-warmpin-after
options.description: MoE: expert accesses to observe before warm-pinning  selects the hot set (default 512). Only used with --moe-warmpin. Env:  SHARPI_MOE_WARMPIN_AFTER.

options.name: --n-gpu-layers
options.description: Layers on GPU (0=CPU only, -1=all, default: 0)

options.name: --n-predict
options.description: Number of tokens to predict (default: 512)

options.name: --no-display-prompt
options.description: Don't echo the prompt

options.name: --no-moe-predict-prefetch
options.description: MoE: disable next-layer predictive expert prefetch  (Vulkan; on by default). Env: SHARPI_MOE_PREDICT_PREFETCH=0.

options.name: --no-thinking
options.description: Disable reasoning mode (sets enable_thinking=false in the  chat template)

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Input prompt (default: interactive chat)

options.name: --rep-penalty
options.description: Repetition penalty (1.0 = disabled, >1.0 penalizes  repeated tokens, default: 1.1)

options.name: --seed
options.description: RNG seed (-1 = random, default: -1)

options.name: --single-turn
options.description: Generate one response and exit

options.name: --spec-draft-n-max
options.description: Max draft tokens per MTP step (default: 1). Currently only N=1 is supported on the MTP path; issue #30 will lift this. Mirrors llama.cpp.

options.name: --spec-draft-n-min
options.description: Min draft tokens per MTP step (default: 0). Mirrors  llama.cpp. Currently rejected at parse time when > 0 since N=1 is the only  supported draft length; issue #37.

options.name: --spec-draft-p-min
options.description: Min draft probability for MTP probabilistic accept  (default: 1.0 = strict argmax-match, byte-identical to no-MTP baseline). 0.75  mirrors llama.cpp; values in (0, 1) accept drafts whose softmax probability  under the verifier meets the threshold even when they aren't argmax (issue  #38).

options.name: --spec-lookahead
options.description: Number of draft tokens per speculative step with  --draft-model (default: 4)

options.name: --spec-type
options.description: Speculative decoding type: auto (default; enables MTP when supported), none, mtp (alias: draft-mtp). Mirrors llama.cpp.

options.name: --system-prompt
options.description: System prompt

options.name: --temp
options.description: Temperature (0 = greedy, default: 0.7)

options.name: --top-k
options.description: Top-k sampling (0 = disabled, default: 40)

options.name: --top-p
options.description: Top-p nucleus sampling (default: 0.95)

options.name: --tq
options.description: Enable TurboQuant KV cache compression (3-bit, reduces  VRAM ~5x)

options.name: --verbose-prompt
options.description: Print token IDs before generating

commands.name: image

options.name: --backend
options.description: (Z-Image) Force compute backend: auto (default), cuda, vulkan, cpu

options.name: --cfg-scale
options.description: Guidance scale — not used for Z-Image  (distilled), 1.0 for FLUX schnell (default: auto)

options.name: --clip-l
options.description: (FLUX) Path to CLIP-L encoder safetensors

options.name: --clip-tokenizer
options.description: (FLUX) Path to CLIP tokenizer.json

options.name: --height
options.description: Output image height in pixels — must be divisible by 16 (default: 512)

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to diffusion model GGUF or safetensors directory  (FLUX.1, Z-Image-Turbo, …)

options.name: --n-gpu-layers
options.description: (Z-Image) GPU acceleration: -1 = auto  (CUDA→Vulkan→CPU, default), 0 = CPU only

options.name: --negative-prompt
options.description: Negative prompt — what to avoid in the generated  image

options.name: --output
options.description: Output PNG file path (default: output.png)

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate

options.name: --qwen-encoder
options.description: (Z-Image) Path to Qwen3-4B GGUF text encoder (from  Qwen/Qwen3-4B-GGUF)

options.name: --qwen-tokenizer
options.description: (Z-Image) Path to Qwen3 tokenizer.json

options.name: --sd-cli
options.description: Path to sd-cli executable used when --use-sdcpp is set (overrides SHARPI_SDCPP env var)

options.name: --seed
options.description: RNG seed (-1 = random, default: -1)

options.name: --steps
options.description: Denoising steps (default: 4 for Z-Image-Turbo, 4 for  FLUX schnell, 20 for dev)

options.name: --t5-tokenizer
options.description: (FLUX) Path to T5 tokenizer.json

options.name: --t5xxl
options.description: (FLUX) Path to T5-XXL encoder safetensors

options.name: --text-encoder
options.description: (sd-cli mode only) Path to LLM-style text encoder  GGUF

options.name: --upscale-blend
options.description: Blend factor for the upscaled result (0.0–1.0).  1.0 = full RRDB (sharpest), <1.0 softens by blending with bicubic. Default  1.0.

options.name: --upscaler
options.description: Path to ESRGAN/Real-ESRGAN upscaler weights  (.safetensors). Upscales the generated image by ×2 or ×4 before  saving.

options.name: --use-sdcpp
options.description: Delegate to stable-diffusion.cpp sd-cli instead of  native pipeline (for comparison)

options.name: --vae
options.description: Path to VAE safetensors file or directory  (ae.safetensors or vae/ dir)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show per-step timing and progress

options.name: --width
options.description: Output image width in pixels — must be divisible  by 16 (default: 512)

commands.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using a native FLUX  or Z-Image-Turbo diffusion pipeline (VAE + CLIP-L + T5-XXL + DiT  GGUF). See 'sharpi-cli image --help' for required model paths.
